organizations.sources: Cuyahoga County harvest 2026-10-28 [C-Process+City; D-ED/News]; https://www.tarkettexchange.com/m/576157d176c241c8/Tarkett_SHEET-VINYL_-Performa-HE-Specification.pdf; https://www.tarketthome.com/TarkettResidential/media/Tarkett-Residential/Product%20Documents/Hard%20Flooring/LVT/LVT_ProGenPlus_Specs.pdf?ext=.pdf; Grok team Ohio list 2026-10-28 [FactoryRegistry; ODOD]; evidence: https://www.factoryregistry.com/industry/326-plastics-rubber-products/oh; Grok team Ohio list 2026-10-28 [EPA (FRS/ECHO/TRI); FactoryRegistry; OSHA ITA]; evidence: https://www.osha.gov/sites/default/largefiles/ITA_300A_Summary_Data_2025_through_08-31-2026.csv
organizations.notes: Harvest ring call was 4->1, resolved to 1: Tarkett is a flooring manufacturer (polymer product is its identity) but the Solon footprint is the NA HQ/technical services, not a plant - flooring is manufactured elsewhere. Its Middlefield distribution center (Geauga Co.) closed Feb 2025 and is not staged. Pass 4 (packets 01 + 03): the Middlefield plant at 16035 Industrial Pkwy is NOT closed — closure/lease signals attach to the adjacent 16077 Industrial Pkwy building (LoopNet listing). Status stays active. NAICS validity fix 2026-10-29 pass 5 (V-1): 326192 is INVALID (absent from the official NAICS 2017 and 2022 structures; a 2002/2007-era code). Org landing is a TRANSFERRED adjudication (flagged): the adjudicated org row was the staged Johnsonite record (ORG-000596, tombstoned here); this org spans vinyl + rubber flooring and FRS attests 326199 for both Tarkett facilities in evidence — primary 326199, secondary 326299.
